# Peak

> Peak is an AI Vedic astrology app: chart-specific guidance for work, relationships, money, health, and timing — not generic sun-sign content.

Peak helps people ask real questions about their life and get answers grounded in their birth chart, location, and goals. The marketing site (this host) explains the product; the app runs at https://app.peaklife.me.

## Preferred sources

- [Home](https://peaklife.me/): product overview and positioning
- [How it works](https://peaklife.me/product/how-it-works/): method and product flow
- [Ask](https://peaklife.me/product/ask/): chart-based Q&A
- [Daily guidance](https://peaklife.me/product/daily-guidance/): day and hour guidance
- [Goals](https://peaklife.me/product/goals/): timing around goals
- [Hora timing](https://peaklife.me/product/hora-timing/): planetary hour timing
- [Blog](https://peaklife.me/blog/): articles and product notes
- [Jyotish guides](https://peaklife.me/jyotish/): planetary placements and ascendants
- [Contact](https://peaklife.me/contact/): support
- [Privacy](https://peaklife.me/privacy-policy/)
- [Terms](https://peaklife.me/terms/)

- Web app: https://app.peaklife.me
